get.summary: Projects of the current user, newest first

post.summary: Create a project (with its hidden root task)

delete.summary: Delete a project and its whole task tree

get.summary: One level: the task, its breadcrumb and its children in order

post.summary: 新建: append a task at the end of this level

delete.summary: 左滑删除: delete a task (and everything under it); returns its parent level

put.summary: 保存: replace the order of this level

get.summary: Route summary and 准备清单 for this level (optionally a selected scope)

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Comma-separated child ids (勾选). Omit for the whole level.

patch.summary: Mark a prerequisite done / not done

post.summary: 完成: mark a leaf task done

delete.summary: 上一项: mark a leaf task not done

post.summary: Start the run over (clears task completion, keeps prerequisites)

get.summary: Notes of the current user, newest first
One note with transcript, draft and imports

patch.summary: Update title, duration, transcript or speakers

delete.summary: Delete a note and its audio

post.summary: Signed URL to upload one audio segment

get.summary: Signed URLs to play the audio

post.summary: Extract task chains from the transcript (AI draft)

put.summary: Replace the draft after the user edited it

post.summary: Write the confirmed steps into a project level

CreateNote.description: Client-chosen id makes a retried create idempotent.

CreateTask.description: Appended at the end of the level. short defaults to name.

Extraction.description: The AI draft. version increases on every change; stale writes get 409.

ImportPick.description: places is keyed by step id.

Level.description: One level of the task tree, children in execution order.

LevelPlan.description: Map + 准备清单 for one level and scope. Distances are straight-line until real routing lands; objective/travel are accepted but do not change results yet.

NextStep.description: stage is set when the next step is in a different stage; prerequisites then include every entered stage’s own.

Project.description: rootTaskId is the hidden top task whose children are the first level.

Quote.description: The transcript span a step was drawn from.

ReorderLevel.description: The complete new order of the level (same ids, any order).

RunState.description: 进行中: current = first incomplete leaf in plan order.

path.description: Stages from top level to parent.

TaskSummary.description: One row of a level list. lat/lng null = 未定位. place + address identify the spot for map apps.

TranscriptLine.description: speaker is a Speaker id, null = unlabelled.

UpdateExtraction.description: version is the one the edit was based on; mismatch = 409.

UploadTicket.description: Signed URL; the phone PUTs the audio straight to storage.

Urgency.description: early = 尽早订（限量）, before = 行前订, onsite = 现场办
